```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

savepath <-  "/home/ajackson/Dropbox/Rprojects/Curated_Data_Files/Houston_Permits/"

url_begin_a <- "https://www.houstontx.gov/planning/DevelopRegs/docs_pdfs/Permit_eReport/"
url_begin_b <- "https://www.houstonpermittingcenter.org/sites/g/files/nwywnm431/files/"

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

Paths changed at the end of 2025. Most of December is missing - the links on the
website give a "Page not found". Note that Jan 1-13 is special and was 
downloaded manually.

```{r} 
#| echo: FALSE 
#| warning: FALSE

#   Read in list of files and read them in for 2025

filenames <- read_csv(paste0(savepath, "URLs_to_12_1_2025.txt"))

for (filename in filenames$Filenames) { # read files in and save them
  print(paste("Read file", filename))
  if (str_detect(filename, "^#")) {next} # bad file, commented out
  outname <- str_remove(filename, "/|\\s")
  print(paste("Output", outname))
  download.file(paste0(url_begin_a, filename), destfile=paste0(savepath, outname), mode="wb")
}

#   Read in list of files and read them in for 2026

filenamesb <- read_csv(paste0(savepath, "URLs_Jan_2026_to_6_24_2026.txt"))

for (filename in filenamesb$Filenames) { # read files in and save them
  print(paste("Read file", filename))
  if (str_detect(filename, "^#")) {next} # bad file, commented out
  outname <- str_remove(filename, "/|\\s")
  print(paste("Output", outname))
  download.file(paste0(url_begin_b, filename), destfile=paste0(savepath, outname), mode="wb")
}

#   had to download these manually
filenames <- filenames %>% add_row(Filenames="2025Web-eReport-01-06-2025.docx")
filenamesb <- filenamesb %>% add_row(Filenames="2026-05April27_May%2003.xlsx")

#   Combine filename files

filenames <- rbind(filenames, filenamesb)

```


parse files


```{r}

#   Now parse each file

# outname <- "2025Web-eReport-Permits-12-01-2025.xlsx"
# outname <- "2024Web%20eReport%20-%2012-02-2024.docx"
# outname <- "2024Web-eReport-Permits-12-03-2024-to-12-30-2024.xlsx"

for (filename in filenames$Filenames) { # read files in and extract
  if (str_detect(filename, "^#")) {next} # bad file, commented out
  filename <- str_replace(filename,"doc$", "docx") # I reformatted the doc file
  filename <- str_replace(filename,"pdf$", "docx") # I reformatted the pdf file
  outname <- str_remove(filename, "/|\\s")
  outname <- str_remove(outname, "^\\d*/")
  # outname <- str_replace_all(outname, "%20", "-")
  print(paste("Input", outname))
  fileout <- paste0(savepath, outname, ".rds")
  fileout <- str_replace_all(fileout, "%20", "-")
  
  if (str_detect(outname, "xlsx")) { # Oh for God's sake, some are excel????
      tmp <- readxl::read_excel(paste0(savepath, outname), col_names=FALSE)  
      tmp <- tmp[-c(1:5),] 
      names(tmp) <- c("Zipcode", "Permit_date", "Permit_type", "Project_no", 
                    "Address", "Comments")
      tmp <- tmp %>% 
        filter(str_detect(Zipcode, "^77"))
      if (!str_detect(tmp$Permit_date[1], "/")){ # not always stored as a date in excel
        tmp <- tmp %>% mutate(Permit_date = 
                                as.character(
                                  as.Date(as.numeric(Permit_date), 
                                          origin = "1899-12-30")))
      }
      saveRDS(tmp, fileout)
  } else {
    report <- docxtractr::read_docx(paste0(savepath, outname))
    tables <- docxtractr::docx_extract_all_tbls(report)
    if (length(tables[[1]])>=6){
      tmp <- tables[[1]]
    } else {
      tmp <- tables[[2]]
    }
    tmp <- tmp[-c(1:2),] 
    names(tmp) <- c("Zipcode", "Permit_date", "Permit_type", "Project_no", 
                    "Address", "Comments")
    tmp <- tmp %>% 
      filter(str_detect(Zipcode, "^77"))  
    
    saveRDS(tmp, fileout)
    
  }
}

```

Join the tables together

```{r} 
#| echo: FALSE 
#| warning: FALSE

library(purrr)

# 1. Get all .rds files in your directory
files <- list.files(path = savepath, pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)

# 2. Filter for files modified within the last week
# Sys.time() - as.difftime(1, units = "weeks") computes the cutoff time
recent_files <- files[file.info(files)$mtime > (Sys.time() - as.difftime(1, units = "weeks"))]

# 3. Read and combine into a single data frame
combined_data <- recent_files %>% 
  map(readRDS) %>% 
  bind_rows()

saveRDS(combined_data,  paste0(savepath, "Permit_data_9-9-2024_6-7-2026.rds"))
```
